# NoC_SDI_Integration

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network-on-chip architecture where SDI (Software-Defined Interconnect) bonds dynamically reconfigure the topology to match neural network communication patterns. Enables adaptive, low-latency routing for spiking neural networks, critical for scaling TCC systems beyond static mesh topologies.
